note: Nine-attribute theses for all sixteen concepts. Design, motion, history, artifact, narrow, question, and activity attributes for each concept also appear in concept-manifest.json; this register adds the conversation-reading and secondary-detail strategies and the thread-side history/artifact relationships.

window-01.name: Proscenium
window-01.design_thesis: Chat is a center stage; history and artifacts are wings on one continuous floor plane.
window-01.conversation_reading_strategy: The stage centers the mounted thread concept at the chosen chat width; wings never overlap the reading column.
window-01.secondary_detail_strategy: Everything secondary lives in the wings or the lintel (search, artifacts menu, kebab); the stage itself carries no chrome.
window-01.narrow_width_strategy: Wings compress to the compact cast list before the stage narrows; declared 520 px floor.
window-01.motion_thesis: Single-axis slides with settle; the floor line is a fixed landmark.
window-01.question_strategy: Delegated to the mounted thread concept; the stage guarantees it uninterrupted width.
window-01.activity_strategy: Delegated to the thread concept; wings stay still while work runs so motion reads against a calm frame.
window-01.history_strategy: Left wing with four real geometries (closed, peek overlay, pinned compact cast list, pinned full) plus archive view.
window-01.artifact_relationship: Set-piece wing left of the stage: arch header, status chip, tab switcher, editor handoff, error/retry.

window-02.name: Bindery
window-02.design_thesis: A bound working document: recto chat page, verso artifact page, spine of thumb-tabs, fixed gutter.
window-02.conversation_reading_strategy: The recto page keeps a book-like reading measure under a running head with folio flags.
window-02.secondary_detail_strategy: Secondary state lives on the spine (thread dots), the running head margins, and the verso folio labels.
window-02.narrow_width_strategy: Contents leaf yields first, verso clamps second, recto measure holds.
window-02.motion_thesis: Fold-and-settle; leaves lay flat from slight compression; the gutter never moves.
window-02.question_strategy: Thread-owned; the page guarantees stable footprint room above the composer.
window-02.activity_strategy: Thread-owned; the gutter separates work on the verso side from prose on the recto side when an artifact diff is open.
window-02.history_strategy: Spine thumb-tabs (always-on wayfinding) + contents leaf with dot leaders for peek/pinned-full; compact keeps only the spine.
window-02.artifact_relationship: The facing verso page with plate-numbered switching — the strongest 'document beside conversation' reading of the eight.

window-03.name: Instrument Deck
window-03.design_thesis: Labeled instrument cells above a calm bay; state is read on the deck, conversation in the bay.
window-03.conversation_reading_strategy: The bay holds only the transcript column; every selector moved to the deck so the reading column has zero chrome.
window-03.secondary_detail_strategy: Instruments: route/mode/access/BSD cell, artifact counter cell, tools cell; each labeled in small caps.
window-03.narrow_width_strategy: Cell labels drop, the film-strip steps to compact, the bay floor holds.
window-03.motion_thesis: Stepped, mechanical, split-flap value changes; no drift.
window-03.activity_strategy: Thread-owned; the deck's artifact counter and status lamps carry the only window-level activity signals.
window-03.history_strategy: Vertical film-strip with sprocket margins; frames show title/state/age; compact = glyph frames; peek overlays the bay.
window-03.artifact_relationship: Auxiliary monitor with bezel, AUX badge, status lamp, numbered channels — an operator's aux display left of Chat.

window-04.name: Depth Field
window-04.design_thesis: A shallow depth field: front chat plane, rear planes for history and artifacts, edges visible in a rim stack.
window-04.conversation_reading_strategy: The front plane casts a soft shadow over the rears, keeping the transcript unambiguously primary.
window-04.secondary_detail_strategy: The rim stack itself is the secondary-state display: raised edges show what exists and what is forward.
window-04.narrow_width_strategy: Planes recede to the rim; the front plane keeps the floor.
window-04.motion_thesis: Advance/recede along an implied z-axis via precomputed scale and shadow; surfaces always come from and return to the rim.
window-04.activity_strategy: Thread-owned; plane depth never animates during turns so work motion stays on the front plane.
window-04.history_strategy: Card plane: floating peek, docked full, glyph compact; every card is a thread shell with elevation hover.
window-04.artifact_relationship: The artifact plane advances from the rim, docks left of chat, and carries a stack switcher at its foot; Glass themes give planes their sheens.

window-05.name: Workbench
window-05.design_thesis: A co-equal artifact bench with tab rail and status shelf; chat defends a reading floor; history is a tool drawer.
window-05.conversation_reading_strategy: Chat is one of two work areas; its floor rule guarantees the conversation never becomes a sidebar.
window-05.secondary_detail_strategy: The bench shelf carries path/status/handoff; the drawer handle and 2px rails signal sturdiness without color.
window-05.narrow_width_strategy: Drawer compacts first, bench clamps second, chat floor holds third.
window-05.motion_thesis: Short quick snaps with square timing — a drawer thunks, a tab seats.
window-05.activity_strategy: Thread-owned; the bench shows artifact-side consequences (updated stamp) while chat shows the work.
window-05.history_strategy: Tool drawer: peek slides over the bench, pinned full is a fixed slat, compact is a glyph rail.
window-05.artifact_relationship: The bench IS the thesis: tabs, work surface, shelf — the strongest 'artifacts as co-equal work' reading.

window-06.name: Reading Room
window-06.design_thesis: Typographic calm; hairline chrome; margin-note history; reference-desk artifacts.
window-06.conversation_reading_strategy: Everything defers to the measure: the runner header is capped to the chat width and search dissolves into the margin until focused.
window-06.secondary_detail_strategy: Secondary state is typographic: italic notes, small-caps eyebrows, underlined shelf cards.
window-06.narrow_width_strategy: Margins fold away; the room keeps its measure; nothing overlays the text.
window-06.motion_thesis: Ink settling — tiny rise and opacity bloom; nothing slides.
window-06.question_strategy: Thread-owned; Longhand's interview reads most at home here, but every thread concept keeps the room's quiet.
window-06.activity_strategy: Thread-owned; the room never adds its own activity chrome.
window-06.history_strategy: A margin-note column: italic two-line annotations with age; compact = margin marks (·, ?, ◆ as text glyphs); peek floats one note card.
window-06.artifact_relationship: A reference desk: eyebrow label, inset paper surface, underlined shelf of related references — consulted, not operated.

window-07.name: Mosaic
window-07.design_thesis: A board of dockable tiles with visible handles and a shared gap rhythm; closing files a tile into the tray.
window-07.conversation_reading_strategy: The chat tile is first among equals: it always keeps its floor and its header carries the thread identity.
window-07.secondary_detail_strategy: Tile heads and tray chips carry all secondary state; the board's gaps are the hierarchy.
window-07.narrow_width_strategy: History tile compacts, artifact tile clamps, tray absorbs the rest.
window-07.motion_thesis: Reflow choreography along flex tracks; the tray chip is the tile's continuation.
window-07.activity_strategy: Thread-owned; tile filing gives completion its condensation gesture at the window level.
window-07.history_strategy: The thread tile: dock (pinned full), narrow (compact), lift (peek), file (closed → tray chip with reopen).
window-07.artifact_relationship: The artifact tile with footer chip switching; filing it to the tray keeps a labeled, countable handle visible.

window-08.name: Periscope
window-08.design_thesis: Overlay-first adaptive shell: lens dock raises overlays at narrow widths; surfaces crystallize into docked geometry when wide.
window-08.conversation_reading_strategy: At narrow widths the transcript owns the full workspace; surfaces borrow space as overlays instead of squeezing it.
window-08.secondary_detail_strategy: The lens dock is the secondary-state display: raised lenses, stems to docked surfaces.
window-08.narrow_width_strategy: The thesis itself: narrow is the native form; the crystallization threshold (980 px observed) is a property switch, not a breakpoint jump in content.
window-08.motion_thesis: Lens morphs — scale from the control's origin, collapse back into it.
window-08.question_strategy: Thread-owned; overlays auto-avoid the composer region.
window-08.activity_strategy: Thread-owned; lens raise states mirror open work surfaces.
window-08.history_strategy: One surface, two forms: overlay panel or docked column, same rows, same state machine; compact narrows the docked form.
window-08.artifact_relationship: The artifact lens raises a surface with circular per-artifact foot lenses; docked form sits left of Chat per canon.

thread-c01.name: Screenplay
thread-c01.design_thesis: A bubble-less typographic script with margin speakers and stage-direction system work.
thread-c01.conversation_reading_strategy: One prose column at 68ch; margin folds above prose under 620 px container width.
thread-c01.secondary_detail_strategy: Hover-revealed times and text-only action rows; flags (lens, redirect, stopped) as quiet outline chips.
thread-c01.narrow_width_strategy: Margin folds; directions and scenes keep full width; the form scene keeps its footprint.
thread-c01.motion_thesis: Rise-and-settle entries; in-place text replacement for directions; reduced motion = instant final states.
thread-c01.question_strategy: Inline form scene: lettered options, dots, stable footprint, skip reversal, required-answer error, cancel record. Freeform renders as a 'Something else' option row that expands into an inline input (video 2).
thread-c01.activity_strategy: Live bracketed direction + ruled scene blocks (Goal/Tasks/Agents/Diffs) with independent collapse; history condenses to reopenable directions.
thread-c01.history_strategy: Virtualized older messages behind a 'Load earlier' seam that names the unloaded count; search reveals hidden regions and preserves the anchor.
thread-c01.artifact_relationship: Diff scene lines and artifact mentions open the window's left workspace; the script never embeds a viewer.

thread-c02.name: Courier
thread-c02.design_thesis: Deliveries with spatial lineage; one evolving locus pill for live work.
thread-c02.conversation_reading_strategy: Asymmetric bubbles capped at 78% width; hover stamps; sibling action rows.
thread-c02.narrow_width_strategy: Bubbles widen toward full measure; the manifest and question card span the column.
thread-c02.secondary_detail_strategy: The dockband (locus pill + manifest) holds all secondary state below the transcript, above the composer.
thread-c02.motion_thesis: FLIP travel from composer to slot; pill transforms in place; morph card from pill silhouette. Sent deliveries ride a smooth scroll-follow so the thread visibly yields during travel (video 1).
thread-c02.question_strategy: Pill → card → pill morph with a segment trail, skip reversal, and required-answer error in the card.
thread-c02.activity_strategy: Locus pill (summary + timer) and the delivery manifest (goal/tasks/agents/diffs as one expandable strip); completed work is the reply's tools seam. The locus pill carries live phase detail rows; the condensed seam wears the phase-icon strip (video 3).
thread-c02.history_strategy: Sealed earlier deliveries with count; search unseals the needed slice exactly.
thread-c02.artifact_relationship: Manifest diff rows and seam entries hand off to the left workspace.

thread-c03.name: Ledgerline
thread-c03.design_thesis: A ruled ledger with a structural time gutter; work posts and reconciles.
thread-c03.conversation_reading_strategy: Full-width entries, 70ch prose measure, gutter timestamps keep the column clean.
thread-c03.secondary_detail_strategy: Everything secondary is a typed posting line — no cards, no chips beyond flags.
thread-c03.narrow_width_strategy: The gutter narrows but survives; postings wrap their values under the label.
thread-c03.motion_thesis: Unfurl from the rule; caret blink on the active line; reconciliation closes with one movement.
thread-c03.question_strategy: Form ledger: numbered lines, right answer column, active line opens in place, post-answers gate.
thread-c03.activity_strategy: Open postings section for turn/goal/tasks/agents/edits; double-rule reconciliation lines reopen into postings.
thread-c03.history_strategy: Prior pages metaphor for unloaded history; exact jumps turn back only as far as needed.
thread-c03.artifact_relationship: Edit postings open the diff artifact in the window's workspace.

thread-c04.name: Dossier
thread-c04.design_thesis: Folder-card messages, one tabbed case file, paged forms with a review page.
thread-c04.conversation_reading_strategy: Self-contained paper cards with corner role tabs; user cards mirror right.
thread-c04.secondary_detail_strategy: The case file's tabs are the secondary-state system; nothing else accumulates.
thread-c04.narrow_width_strategy: Cards span the column; the case file tabs scroll horizontally inside their strip.
thread-c04.motion_thesis: Filing slides on the stack axis; tab content switches in a fixed frame; submission stamps shut.
thread-c04.question_strategy: Page tabs + Review page with per-question answer summary before submit; strongest review-and-reverse of the eight.
thread-c04.activity_strategy: The case file: Goal / Tasks / Agents / Changes tabs, full controls each, stable footprint; filed records reopen inside message cards.
thread-c04.history_strategy: Cabinet metaphor for unloaded documents; pulls only what search or the seam requests.
thread-c04.artifact_relationship: The Changes tab and filed diffs open the left workspace.

thread-c05.name: Longhand
thread-c05.design_thesis: One continuous manuscript; typographic rules for system events; an interview for questions.
thread-c05.conversation_reading_strategy: A 66ch centered column; your words in italic accent ink; asterisms separate exchanges.
thread-c05.secondary_detail_strategy: Secondary state is written into the record as prose and rules; superscript task states.
thread-c05.narrow_width_strategy: The measure narrows gracefully; rules and the interview keep the column.
thread-c05.motion_thesis: Page-growth only; the live rule breathes; nothing slides.
thread-c05.question_strategy: Inline interview: italic prompts, em-dash answers, ruled freeform, pass over / reconsider / abandon / set-the-answers.
thread-c05.activity_strategy: A live running rule plus work paragraphs (goal sentence with controls, task list with superscripts, hands, edits as prose).
thread-c05.history_strategy: Previous leaves for unloaded passages; jumps write the needed leaves back in.
thread-c05.artifact_relationship: Edit paragraphs are links to the left workspace; the manuscript never embeds panels.

thread-c06.name: Counterweight
thread-c06.design_thesis: Asymmetric voices with footnote metadata and a counterweight work column.
thread-c06.conversation_reading_strategy: Editorial full-measure assistant column with footnote references; compact right counters for you.
thread-c06.secondary_detail_strategy: Numbered footnotes carry all metadata; the pan carries all work state.
thread-c06.narrow_width_strategy: Counters and pan widen to 78%; the beam keeps its alternation.
thread-c06.motion_thesis: Weights drop and the beam levels; completion empties the pan.
thread-c06.question_strategy: The ballot: roman numerals, abstain/withdraw/cast vocabulary, full-measure rows.
thread-c06.activity_strategy: The pan: goal weight with controls, task bars, agent lines, diff weights — a literal counterweight to the prose.
thread-c06.history_strategy: Raising earlier exchanges above the beam; anchors preserved.
thread-c06.artifact_relationship: Diff weights open the left workspace.

thread-c07.name: Teletype
thread-c07.design_thesis: A monospaced wire feed with one rewriting status line and boxed forms.
thread-c07.conversation_reading_strategy: Dashed transmission headers and a 76ch mono measure; fast scanning.
thread-c07.secondary_detail_strategy: The single status band compresses all work state; wire summaries number their lines.
thread-c07.narrow_width_strategy: The grid holds; the status line ellipsizes; the form keeps its frame.
thread-c07.motion_thesis: Stepped carriage feeds, hard-cut status swaps, cursor block only while receiving.
thread-c07.question_strategy: Boxed form with numbered key hints, checkbox marks, bracket-key nav, FORM INCOMING / TRANSMITTING lifecycle.
thread-c07.activity_strategy: One status line (GOAL/TASKS/HANDS/EDITS) that opens into a typed panel; rollups replay completed work line by line.
thread-c07.history_strategy: The spool: rewind loads earlier transmissions; search jumps reveal exact lines.
thread-c07.artifact_relationship: Edit panel lines open the left workspace.

thread-c08.name: Choreograph
thread-c08.design_thesis: Authored entrances and an orbiting satellite that docks into finished work.
thread-c08.conversation_reading_strategy: Soft cards, staggered arcs on entry, calm at rest for long reading.
thread-c08.secondary_detail_strategy: The troupe block and stack chip hold secondary state; docked satellites mark recorded work.
thread-c08.narrow_width_strategy: Cards widen; the troupe wraps its dancers; the dealt card spans the column.
thread-c08.motion_thesis: Arc + anticipation + settle; orbit only during true activity; reduced motion swaps orbit for a solid ring.
thread-c08.question_strategy: The dealt hand: cards deal in, answered cards tuck into the stack chip, fan-out review before submit. Single-select answers auto-advance the dealt card (video 4).
thread-c08.activity_strategy: Orbit frame (live summary + timer), troupe (dancer discs, step bars, goal badge), dock-on-complete into the message.
thread-c08.history_strategy: Scenes in the wings; recalled on demand; anchors preserved.
thread-c08.artifact_relationship: Troupe diff lines open the left workspace.

correction_2026_08_13: After opening the raw videos (correction packet): all eight thread concepts render rich live activity phases in their own voice; Courier adds smooth-yield delivery, a phase-icon seam strip, and the Skip-slot swap; Screenplay renders freeform as a 'Something else' expandable option row; Choreograph auto-advances single-select cards. Concept identities and the nine-attribute theses are otherwise unchanged — the corrections deepened each thesis rather than replacing it.
